voiceId.title: Voice Id
voiceId.description: The voice ID to use for speech synthesis (e.g., Joanna, Matthew, Amy, Brian).

outputFormat.title: Output Format
outputFormat.description: The audio format in which the resulting stream will be encoded.

textType.title: Text Type
textType.description: Specifies whether the input text is plain text or SSML.

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: Specifies the engine (standard, neural, long-form, generative) for Amazon Polly to use when processing input text for speech synthesis.

languageCode.title: Language Code
languageCode.description: Optional language code for voice synthesis. This is only necessary if using a bilingual voice.

accessKey.title: Access Key
accessKey.description: The access key obtained from AWS.

secretKey.title: Secret Key
secretKey.description: The secret key obtained from AWS.

useDefaultCredentialsProvider.title: Default Credentials Provider
useDefaultCredentialsProvider.description: If true, the Polly client loads credentials through a default credentials provider. If false, it uses the basic authentication method (access key and secret key).

useProfileCredentialsProvider.title: Profile Credentials Provider
useProfileCredentialsProvider.description: Set whether the Polly client should expect to load credentials through a profile credentials provider.

useSessionCredentials.title: Session Credentials
useSessionCredentials.description: Set whether the Polly client should expect to use Session Credentials. This is useful in a situation in which the user needs to assume an IAM role for doing operations in Polly.

profileCredentialsName.title: Profile Credentials Name
profileCredentialsName.description: If using a profile credentials provider this parameter sets the profile name.

sessionToken.title: Session Token
sessionToken.description: Amazon AWS Session Token used when the user needs to assume an IAM role.

uriEndpointOverride.title: Overwrite Endpoint URI
uriEndpointOverride.description: The overriding endpoint URI. To use this option, you must also select the `overrideEndpoint` option.

overrideEndpoint.title: Endpoint Overwrite
overrideEndpoint.description: Select this option to override the endpoint URI. To use this option, you must also provide a URI for the `uriEndpointOverride` option.
